subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should optional opaque `OpenClawPluginToolContext.runId` become the permanent public contract for plugin-owned per-run resources used by this browser lifecycle fix?
rationale: The browser plugin needs stable run ownership without importing core internals, but exposing that identity to every tool plugin creates an enduring SDK contract whose scope and semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the documented contract
options.body: Accept optional opaque `runId` as the generic plugin ownership seam, preserving the documentation and SDK boundary tests in this PR.

options.title: Use a narrower runtime capability
options.body: Replace the general identifier with an injected browser or resource-ownership capability before merging, avoiding a broadly reusable SDK field.

options.title: Split the decisions
options.body: Land only the lifecycle decoupling after redesigning ownership, and discuss the general Plugin SDK contract separately.

recommendation.title: Approve the documented contract
recommendation.body: Accept optional opaque `runId` as the generic plugin ownership seam, preserving the documentation and SDK boundary tests in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most strongly to subagent lifecycle, MCP retirement, and agent runtime ownership decisions.
